subject: literacy
concept: Identifying the main idea of a short passage
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading comprehension sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts sentence cards into 'main idea' and 'detail' piles after hearing a short passage
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the picture that best represents the main idea of a short passage
exercise.abstract: Student states the main idea of a short written passage in their own words

misconception_flags: names a specific detail instead of the overall main idea

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
